counting_assumptions: Reported and passed floors are calibrated to the macOS SwiftPM lane with Swift 6.3.1, CI=true, and Swift Testing xUnit output; review them when that toolchain or lane changes.
The source floor is a lexical inventory of @Test declarations in every Swift file under Tests/SwiftVLCTests, including declarations behind platform conditionals; it is not an executed-test count.

The uncontracted skip ceiling excludes only the exact native-version identities below. CI is transitioning from the released extension-version-9 artifact to the rebuilt extension-version-10 artifact, so the five version-10 text-subtitle scenarios receive allowances only before that upgrade. The retained version-8 boundary contracts remain mutually exclusive: four audio-session scenarios apply before version 8, while the reciprocal pre-version-8 rejection applies on version 8 or newer, preserving the same general skip-debt ceiling across that historical artifact boundary.
